answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 76 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is published against the nebula challenge, the garden audit can replay the ripple history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 1297 identities would post 4206 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
